title: Lumefantrine ameliorates DSS-induced colitis by targeting FLI-1 to suppress NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Yang, Ji; Guo, Peng; Luo, Hongtao; Tang, Xin; Liu, Wei; Ren, Xiaolin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗疟药Lumefantrine通过靶向转录因子FLI-1抑制NF-kB信号改善结肠炎，虽涉及TF-DNA相关信号通路，但核心是药物抗炎机制与湿实验验证，缺乏TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作建模的AI/物理模拟方法，仅计算对接为辅助，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Current therapeutic options for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remain suboptimal due to limited efficacy, significant side effects, and high relapse rates, necessitating novel treatment strategies. Lumefantrine, a clinically established antimalarial drug, emerges as a compelling repurposing candidate based on its putative anti-inflammatory activity, though its efficacy and mechanism in IBD remain unexplored. METHODS: A murine IBD model was induced by 3% dextran sulfate sodium (DSS). Mice received oral Lumefantrine (20 mg/kg/day) for 7 days. Disease progression was monitored via disease activity index (DAI) scoring and histological analysis. Serum cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha) and colonic inflammatory mediators (Cox-2, iNos) were quantified by ELISA and qPCR. Tight junction proteins (Claudin-1, ZO-1) were assessed by immunohistochemistry and Western blot. Molecular targets were identified through computational docking and pull-down assays. Additionally, NF-kappaB signaling modulation was assessed in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated intestinal epithelial cells (IEC-6 and NCM460) via Western blot analysis. RESULTS: Oral administration of Lumefantrine significantly attenuated disease activity index (DAI) scores and restored intestinal barrier integrity through upregulation of epithelial tight junction proteins Claudin-1 and ZO-1. Treated mice exhibited reduced serum levels of IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha, along with decreased colonic expression of inflammatory mediators cyclooxygenase-2 (Cox-2) and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNos). Computational and experimental approaches identified FLI-1 a transcription factor upregulated in IBD colon tissues as Lumefantrine's direct binding target. This interaction mediated suppression of NF-kappaB signaling, specifically downregulating phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha and p65 in LPS-stimulated intestinal epithelial cells. CONCLUSION: Lumefantrine ameliorates experimental colitis through FLI-1-dependent inhibition of the NF-kappaB pathway, demonstrating high repurposing potential as an IBD therapeutic.
abstract_zh: 背景：当前针对炎症性肠病（IBD）的治疗方案因疗效有限、显著副作用和高复发率而仍不理想，亟需新型治疗策略。苯芴醇（Lumefantrine）作为一种临床已确立的抗疟药物，基于其推测的抗炎活性，成为有吸引力的药物再利用候选，但其在IBD中的疗效和机制尚未被探索。方法：通过3%葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导小鼠IBD模型。小鼠接受口服苯芴醇（20 mg/kg/天）治疗7天。通过疾病活动指数（DAI）评分和组织学分析监测疾病进展。通过ELISA和qPCR定量血清细胞因子（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α）和结肠炎症介质（Cox-2、iNos）。通过免疫组织化学和Western blot评估紧密连接蛋白（Claudin-1、ZO-1）。通过计算对接和pull-down实验鉴定分子靶点。此外，通过Western blot分析评估脂多糖（LPS）刺激的肠上皮细胞（IEC-6和NCM460）中NF-κB信号调节。结果：口服苯芴醇显著降低疾病活动指数（DAI）评分，并通过上调上皮紧密连接蛋白Claudin-1和ZO-1恢复肠道屏障完整性。治疗小鼠表现出血清IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α水平降低，以及结肠炎症介质环氧合酶-2（Cox-2）和诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNos）表达下降。计算和实验方法鉴定出FLI-1（一种在IBD结肠组织中上调的转录因子）为苯芴醇的直接结合靶点。这种相互作用介导了NF-κB信号的抑制，特别是在LPS刺激的肠上皮细胞中下调IκBα和p65的磷酸化。结论：苯芴醇通过FLI-1依赖性抑制NF-κB通路改善实验性结肠炎，显示出作为IBD治疗药物的高再利用潜力。
